DVD 的 sectors 必须是 16 的倍数。.en: A DVD's sector count must be a multiple of 16.

outerRadiusMm 必须大于 innerRadiusMm。.en: The outer radius must be larger than the inner radius.

outputs.outputPath 不能为空。.en: The output path can't be empty.

{0} 必须是大于 0 的有限数值。.en: {0} must be a finite number greater than 0.

三次轨距参数仅适用于 DVD。.en: Cubic pitch terms only apply to DVD.

三次轨距拟合需要至少 12 个不同半径的点且覆盖至少 60% 绘图区；本次保持轨.en: Fitting the pitch needs at least 12 points at different radii covering 60% of the drawing area. This fit kept the pitch and only fitted the radii.

三次轨距没有带来稳定改善，保留原轨距系数；可增加内、中、外圈点位后重试。.en: Fitting the pitch brought no stable improvement, so it was kept as it was. Add inner, middle and outer points and try again.

不支持 schemaVersion={0}；当前支持 {1} 与 {2}。.en: This project's schema version ({0}) isn't supported. Supported versions are {1} and {2}.

不支持的标定会话版本 {0}。.en: This calibration record's version ({0}) isn't supported.

两条实体轮廓无法同时吻合：外缘误差 {0} px，内缘误差 {1} px。请检查.en: The two outlines can't both fit: {0} px of error on the outer edge and {1} px on the hole. Check both outlines and the disc size.

两条轮廓不能得到有效的联合投影，请检查布点。.en: The two outlines don't give a valid shared perspective. Check the points.

内缘轮廓与外缘位置不符，请确认选中的是贯通的实体内缘，而非盘面的印刷圆环。.en: The hole outline doesn't fit the outer edge. Make sure it follows the actual hole, not a printed ring on the disc.

十字线记录无效。.en: The saved curve points aren't valid.

外缘和内缘各需要至少 5 个分散的点，且每条轮廓不超过 256 个点。.en: Each outline needs at least 5 spread-out points, and at most 256.

外缘轮廓无法形成稳定椭圆，请核对实体外缘上的点。.en: The outer outline doesn't form a stable ellipse. Check the points on the disc's outer edge.

存在形状接近的参数候选，请对照整条曲线后再应用。.en: Other candidates have a similar shape. Compare against the whole curve before applying.

完整曲线采样超出点数上限；请缩小预测范围或提高采样上限后再确认形状。.en: The full curve needs too many points to draw. Narrow the range before checking its shape.

宽范围只进行了有限多起点搜索，候选列表不代表穷尽所有可能参数。.en: A wide range is only searched from a limited number of starting points, so the candidates may not be every possibility.

尚未确认照片矫正，不能保存描线点。.en: Correct the photo before saving curve points.

工程名不能为空。.en: The project name can't be empty.

已拟合 DVD 三次轨距；三个形状系数与内外半径可能互相补偿，低残差不表示参数唯.en: The DVD pitch was fitted. Its terms and the radii can offset each other, so a low error doesn't prove the result is unique. Check the whole predicted curve before applying.

已联合校正外缘与内缘。轮廓误差：外缘 {0} px，内缘 {1} px。请继续核.en: Corrected using both edges, with {0} px of error on the outer edge and {1} px on the hole. Check both outlines.

当前曲线对两个半径的约束较相似，暂不能仅凭低残差判断参数唯一；请扩大径向覆盖并检.en: This curve constrains both radii in a similar way, so a low error doesn't prove the result is unique. Cover more of the radius and check the points' accuracy.

当前点位无法稳定区分三个轨距系数与内外半径，本次保留原轨距系数；请扩大径向覆盖并.en: These points can't separate the pitch terms from the radii, so the pitch was kept. Cover more of the radius and place points more accurately.

拍摄角度或轮廓对应关系导致投影退化，请换角度拍摄或重新布点。.en: The camera angle or the outlines make the perspective unusable. Retake the photo or place the points again.

搜索半径范围应在 0–5 mm 内，控制点容差应在 0–10 mm 内，轨距系数.en: The radius range must be within 0–5 mm, the tolerance within 0–10 mm, and the pitch range within 0–10.

搜索范围内没有能覆盖全部观测点的有效正半径曲线延拓，请检查照片尺度、盘心或参数范.en: No valid curve in the search range covers all the points. Check the photo's scale, the disc centre or the range.

无法识别的工程字段 '{0}'。.en: The project has a field this version doesn't recognize: '{0}'.

曲线偏差较大，请检查照片矫正、点位和是否始终沿同一条线标点。.en: The points are far from the curve. Check the photo correction, the points, and that they all follow one line.

曲线出现明显向内回退，请按内到外的顺序沿同一条线标点。.en: The curve moves back inward. Mark points in order from the inside out along one line.

曲线点坐标无效，请使用矫正后以盘心为原点的坐标。.en: A curve point is invalid. Points must be on the corrected photo, measured from the disc centre.

曲线点数量超出限制。.en: There are too many curve points.

曲线点较多，拟合使用均匀抽取的点；完整顺序仍用于角度展开。.en: With this many points, the fit uses an even sample of them. The full sequence is still used to follow the angle.

曲线覆盖的内外范围偏窄，参数可能互相补偿；请补充更靠内、外的点。.en: The curve covers a fairly narrow band, so the two radii may offset each other. Add points further in and further out.

曲线覆盖范围太窄，无法稳定分离内外半径；请继续标出更靠内、外的曲线。.en: The curve covers too narrow a band to separate the two radii. Extend it further in and further out.

最佳结果靠近搜索边界，建议扩大搜索范围并补充曲线点复核。.en: The best result is near the edge of the search. Widen the range, add points and check again.

有相邻曲线点的转角接近半圈，绕圈判断可能不可靠；请补点后复核。.en: Two neighbouring points are nearly half a turn apart, so the turn count may be unreliable. Add points and check again.

标定会话文件过大。.en: The calibration record is too large.

标定参数无效：请检查盘片类型、内外半径、扇区数和线速度／位长。.en: The calibration settings aren't valid. Check the disc type, radii and sectors.

标定图案与生成参数或图案规则不一致。.en: The target doesn't match its settings or the pattern rules.

标定照片为空或过大，请重新导入照片。.en: The calibration photo is empty or too large. Import it again.

照片中的盘片过小，无法稳定矫正。.en: The disc is too small in the photo to correct reliably.

照片变换产生了无效坐标。.en: The photo correction produced an invalid coordinate.

照片变换退化，无法恢复盘面坐标。.en: The photo correction is degenerate, so disc positions can't be recovered.

照片轮廓控制点无效。.en: The photo's outline points aren't valid.

盘片与内缘的实体尺寸无效。常规盘为直径 120 mm、孔径 15 mm。.en: The disc or hole size isn't valid. A standard disc is 120 mm across with a 15 mm hole.

相邻曲线点转角接近半圈，无法判断是否漏掉整圈；请在这两点之间沿实际曲线补点。.en: Two neighbouring points are nearly half a turn apart, so a full turn could be missing. Add points along the real curve between them.

蓝光 sectors 不能超过单层容量 {0}。.en: A Blu-ray's sector count can't exceed the single-layer capacity of {0}.

蓝光使用恒定轨距，pitch 系数必须为 0。.en: Blu-ray uses a constant track pitch, so the pitch terms must be 0.

蓝光标定需要完整的 32 扇区簇、74.5 nm 位长和不超过 60 mm 的外.en: Blu-ray calibration needs whole 32-sector clusters, a 74.5 nm bit length and an outer radius of at most 60 mm.

蓝光的 sectors 必须是 32 的倍数。.en: A Blu-ray's sector count must be a multiple of 32.

角度展开以相邻点之间没有遗漏整圈为前提；请对照完整曲线，在弯曲或绕行处补点后确认.en: This assumes no full turn is missed between neighbouring points. Compare against the whole curve, and add points at bends or loops.

该位置接近照片投影地平线，无法矫正。.en: This position is too close to the photo's horizon to correct.

该观测半径在当前参数下没有有效的正半径曲线延拓，请检查照片尺度、盘心或参数范围。.en: This radius has no valid curve under these settings. Check the photo's scale, the disc centre or the range.

请分别输入实体外缘和实体内缘轮廓。.en: Mark both the disc's outer edge and the edge of its centre hole.

请沿同一条曲线从内到外至少标出 6 个点，覆盖靠内、中间和靠外的位置。.en: Mark at least 6 points along one curve from the inside out, covering the inner, middle and outer areas.

请选择 12 cm 或 8 cm 光盘。.en: Choose a 12 cm or 8 cm disc.

轨距系数接近搜索边界，请复核点位，必要时扩大系数搜索范围。.en: The pitch terms are near the edge of the search. Check the points, and widen the range if needed.

轮廓中存在无效坐标。.en: An outline has an invalid coordinate.

轮廓点重复或接近一条直线，请沿外缘和内缘分别分散布点。.en: The outline points repeat or nearly form a line. Spread them around the outer edge and the hole edge.

轮廓点集中在局部，请在两条完整圆周的不同方向补点。.en: The outline points are bunched together. Add points around the whole of both circles.

部分描点在候选模型下超出原图案环带，已按连续曲线保留；请复核照片尺度、盘心及端点.en: Some points fall outside the target's ring under this result. They were kept as part of the curve, so check the photo's scale, the disc centre, and that the end points follow the same curve.

预测曲线需要有限、递增且大于零的观测半径区间。.en: The predicted curve needs a finite, increasing range of radii above zero.
